10. On behalf of the appellant it is further contended that the court of appeal below made out a new case by finding that the plaintiff's bargadar possessed the suit land upto 30th Chaitra 1359. B.S. vide the kabuliyat Ext. 5(a) and that if defendants entered into the suit land even on 30th Chaitra 1359 B,S i.e. 13th April, 1953 A.D. the twelve years running from that date ended on 13.4.1%5 A.D. and as the Civil Court was closed from 12th April,I965 to 15th April, 1965 A.D. on account of Eidul Azha and the plaintiffs suit filed on the reopening day of Civil Court on 16th April, 1965 was not barred by limitation, 

 11. This finding of the court of appeal below cannot be construed as a making of a new case as the kabuliyat Ext. 5(a) executed by the plaintiffs bargadar defendant No.10 clearly indicates that the barga agreement was in force till 30th Chaitra,1359 B.S. Defendant No.10 was impleaded in the suit but he did not file any written statement though his name was found in the written suncrncnt filed by the present appellant and afterwards penned through. The trial court held that defendant No. 10 and Hasur Bap were in the camp of defendant No. 2. The court of appeal below observed that no disinterested witness came forward to prove possession of the defendant and held that the defendants 1-7 in collusion with defendants 8-9 dispossessed the plaintiff from the suitland just at the fag end of the month of Chaitra 1359 B.S. The court of appeal below further considered that D.W. 1. stated in his examination in chief that he did not know the schedule of the plaint and in cross examination he further stated that he had no objection If the plaintiff would get a decree with regard to the suit land.
